# @sharadox/database-web-library

> Typed, injection-safe Postgres for web applications: Kysely over a Neon pool, forward-only SQL migrations, Postgres in memory (PGlite) for tests, and an ESLint rule keeping values out of SQL text.

- /database: createDatabase<Schema>({ connectionString }) → Kysely<Schema> over @neondatabase/serverless Pool (PostgresDialect); connects on first query
- /database-configuration: readDatabaseConfiguration(environment = process.env) → { connectionString } from DATABASE_URL (postgres:// or postgresql://, checked with Zod); errors name the variable, never the value
- /migration: migrate(database, migrations: { name, sql }[], { table = "schema_migration" }) → string[] applied; one transaction + pg_advisory_xact_lock; records name + SHA-256 checksum; MigrationError codes changed | missing | out-of-order | invalid-name (table not /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$/)
- /migration-file: readMigrations(folder: URL | string) → Migration[] from files /^\d{4}-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\.sql$/ in order; other files ignored; MigrationError invalid-name | duplicate
- /migration-error: class MigrationError extends Error { name: "MigrationError"; code: "invalid-name" | "duplicate" | "changed" | "missing" | "out-of-order" }
- /memory-database: createMemoryDatabase<Schema>() → { database: Kysely<Schema>, close() }: fresh Postgres 18 in memory; needs @electric-sql/pglite (optional peer)
- /pglite-pool: pglitePool(pglite) → Kysely PostgresPool; one connection at a time; no-parameter queries may hold several statements (exec), result = last
- /es-lint-plugin: databaseEsLintPlugin (configs.recommended enables "@sharadox/database/no-raw-sql"), noRawSql: reports sql.raw, sql.lit, CompiledQuery.raw, .unsafe(), .query() with SQL built by + or `${}`
- Ids: uuid columns `default uuidv7() check (uuid_extract_version(id) = 7)`; uuidVersion7 from @sharadox/web-library in code
- /backup-dump: dumpDatabase(url, { program = "pg_dump", run? }) → Uint8Array (--schema=public --inserts --no-owner --no-privileges --quote-all-identifiers; address parts in PGHOST, PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGDATABASE, PGSSLMODE); restorableSql(dump) drops lines starting with "\"
- /backup-encryption: encryptBackup(bytes, key ≥32 chars) → "SHARADOX-BACKUP-1" + IV(12) + tag(16) + AES-256-GCM ciphertext; decryptBackup(bytes, key)
- /database-backup: backupDatabase({ dump, counts, storage, key, now? }) → { file "YYYY/MM/DD/<ISO>.sql.gz.enc", manifest ".json" { createdAt, file, bytes, sha256, tables }, tables }; tableCounts(database) → { table: rows } (public schema, schema-qualified)
- /restore-drill: restoreDrill({ storage, key, into: Kysely }) → { ok, createdAt, tables: [{ table, expected, restored }] }; throws for no backup or a checksum mismatch
- /backup-storage: createBackupStorage({ bucket, region, prefix, credentials }) → BackupStorage { put, get, list } (no delete; Object Lock); /memory-backup-storage createMemoryBackupStorage()
- /git-hub-web-identity: gitHubWebIdentityToken(environment?) → the Actions OIDC token (audience sts.amazonaws.com)
- /backup-command: runBackupCommand("backup" | "drill", environment?, parts?) → exit code; env BACKUP_BUCKET, BACKUP_REGION, BACKUP_PREFIX, BACKUP_ROLE, BACKUP_ENCRYPTION_KEY, DATABASE_BACKUP_URL (backup)
